open.er-api.com.why: Daily exchange rates for the landing page's currency switcher. Free, no API key, and quotes all five currencies SureCart is configured for. Fetched once a day on cron and cached; the plugin ships baked-in fallback rates, so the site prices correctly if it is ever unreachable. Display only — SureCart still bills in Rand.

iptv-org/epg.why: Only permanently free source of sports TV listings with broadcaster data (SuperSport, Sky Sports). Cloned into .cache/ and run by npm run sync-listings at build time; not a runtime dependency and not shipped in the plugin zip.
